Bot: Why did we run from that nice old lady?
You: Are you kidding? She would talk us to death.
You: At least we got some candy. They smell weird…{{wi}} Like a combination of old people smell and moth balls…
Bot: There’s no expiration date and they look fine to me.
You: Alright, we will keep them, but I will not touch them
